title: The Missing Drone
scene: At 2:50 PM, the shop drone vanished. The flying field was closed during a storm warning from 2:30 to 3:10.

suspects.name: Anita Vale
suspects.testimony: I was flying the drone at 2:50, testing the new camera.
suspects.contradiction: The field was closed at 2:30, and rotor guards were in Anita's bag.

suspects.name: Barry Reed
suspects.testimony: I was in the shop at 2:50, stocking parts.
suspects.alibiProof: The stock log shows Barry's count at 2:48.

suspects.name: Carla Pike
suspects.testimony: I was at the counter at 2:50, paying for a battery.
suspects.alibiProof: The register shows Carla's sale at 2:49.

suspects.name: Devon Ash
suspects.testimony: I was in the cafe at 2:50, waiting out the storm.
suspects.alibiProof: The cafe receipt for Devon is stamped 2:51.
